name: humid_fan_restrict_1693_coordinator_latch_holds_then_releases
description: Real coordinator: the restrict latch engages at a 55.5F indoor dew point, holds at 54.5F (inside the 1F band) and releases at 53.5F, still within 2 h of cooling
notes: Indoor 76.0F at 47.3% = 54.49F; at 45.6% = 53.48F; 77.0F at 47.5% = 55.51F. Outdoor 70.0F at 49.1% = 50.01F dew point (dry: the #1691 humid-air guard does not block).

The coordinator's 5-minute dew-point tick (_sample_humidity_facts -> step_humid_latches) keeps the hvac_fan_restrict_humid latch; each decision re-steps it from the facts (15-minute median dew point).

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: without the latch 54.5F < 55F would lift the restriction and 20:45 would read natural_ventilation; without the humid clause 21:30 would still read paused (cooling ended 20:00). (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md states 55F on / 54F off through latch_above; production steps humidity_facts.HVAC_FAN_RESTRICT_LATCH_SPEC with the other humid latches. (c) occupant: the blower would chatter on and off as the dew point hovers at 55F.
